people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Micaiah
people.line: A prophet who foretold King Ahab's death.

translations.web: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”
translations.bsb: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”
translations.kjv: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
translations.asv: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah.
